ammonia.reason: Short 60d brine ripening with limited deamination, no ammonia quantified.

animal_barnyard.reason: Ewe/goat milk plus p-cresol trace and propanoic acid from wooden-barrel microflora.

bitter.reason: Rennet-derived hydrophobic peptides unmasked by 2-3% salt and low pH.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; 2-heptanone only 12 ug/kg and 2-nonanone ND.

browning.reason: High-moisture acid curd with 0.2% residual lactose, minimal Maillard.

buttery.reason: Very low diacetyl 17 ug/kg ND at 60d and acetoin 190 ug/kg from lactococcal citrate metabolism.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High butanoic acid 2153 ug/kg SPME and 65 mg/kg total plus hexanoic/octanoic from lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 21.5% fat acid-rennet gel stored in brine, no cream homogenization.

crumbliness.reason: Low pH 4.34 demineralized paracasein plus brine salt gives short crumbly fracture.

firmness.reason: 55% moisture brined block, firm sliceable but not hard-grana.

floral_honey.reason: Trace 2-phenylethanol <1-18 ug/kg from phenylalanine catabolism, no honey lactones high.

fruity.reason: Moderate ethyl butanoate 171 ug/kg and ethyl hexanoate 143 ug/kg from esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: 70/30 ewe/goat milk rich in C6-C10 free fatty acids from pregastric lipase lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Transient 3-methylbutanal 8 ug/kg from leucine Strecker, lost by day 60.

melt.reason: Acid pH 4.34 and high brine salt prevents casein flow on heating.

oil_off.reason: Low fat 21.5% high moisture emulsified curd, no free oil on heating.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 164-284 mg/kg plus lactic acid to pH 4.34 from starter fermentation.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd, no hot-water kneading.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd, no methanethiol/DMS detected, pasteurized only.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted to 0.2% and delta-decalactone 12 ug/kg masked by salt-acid.

umami.reason: 60-100d brine proteolysis releasing glutamate enhanced by salt.
